cases.description: Safe ORM with parameterized queries
cases.notes: Uses SQLAlchemy text() with parameter binding via dict. Tainted values (username, search_term, product_id) are passed as parameters (second argument to execute), NOT interpolated into the SQL string. The SQL string itself contains only placeholders (:username, :limit, :search, etc.).

cases.description: Complex taint propagation
cases.notes: Taint flows through replace(), split(), join(), f-strings. replace() is NOT a SQL sanitizer.

cases.description: CVE-2026-21892: Parsl parsl-visualize SQLi via string-format
cases.notes: Parsl's parsl-visualize component uses Python string formatting to build SQL queries from user-supplied task names.

cases.description: CVE-2026-33545: MobSF SQLi via crafted APK filename
cases.notes: MobSF's read_sqlite() embeds APK filenames directly into SQL queries without sanitization.

cases.description: CVE-2025-57833: Django FilteredRelation SQLi via crafted table alias
cases.notes: Django ORM FilteredRelation accepts user-supplied alias that is not sanitized, enabling SQL injection via crafted alias string.

cases.description: CVE-2025-59681: DeepSeek prompt injection → SQLi
cases.notes: LLM-generated SQL with user-controlled column alias enables SQL injection through crafted alias name.

cases.description: CVE-2025-64459: Django Q() SQLi via JSONField key injection
fp_details: sink=cur.execute line=42 arg=query — not in expected sink lines [0]
cases.notes: Django Q() objects with crafted _connector parameter can inject arbitrary SQL through JSONField queries.

cases.description: CVE-2025-67644: LangGraph SQLite checkpoint SQLi via metadata filter keys
cases.notes: LangGraph interpolates metadata filter keys directly into SQL WHERE clause via f-string, allowing SQL injection.
